foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification
capture_clock_note: Automation-run clock reference; web retrieval did not expose an exact per-request client receipt timestamp. Do not treat this as an independently anchored capture timestamp.

receipt_contract.exchange_hash_scope: Exact JSON response text returned by the public API retrieval layer.
receipt_contract.page_excerpt_hash_scope: Exact normalized excerpt strings preserved in this artifact, not complete HTML or original HTTP wire bytes.

spot_sources.field_semantics: Kraken ticker array fields use [today, rolling 24 hours] for volume, VWAP, trade count, low and high. The o field is today's open.
limitations: No provider event timestamp was returned; the run clock is retrieval context, not exchange event time.
Only Level-1 bid/ask and sizes are present; no multi-level depth, executable slippage or cancellation history.
The quote is USD and is not interchangeable with USDT without a timestamped conversion source.

spot_sources.provider_timestamp_semantics: OKX ticker ts is a provider ticker-data timestamp, not independently established as the last-trade event time.
limitations: Age is 239.428 seconds only against the automation run clock reference; the exact web request receipt time is unavailable.
The observation is near the 300-second freshness boundary and is conservatively excluded from model features.
Only Level-1 ticker fields are captured; multi-level order-book depth and executable slippage are unavailable.
USDT is not normalized to USD.

reasons: USD and USDT quote currencies differ.
Kraken supplies no provider event timestamp.
OKX ticker age is near the 300-second threshold and the retrieval clock is not independently anchored.
Only Level-1 data is available; no synchronized multi-level depth, fees, latency or transfer costs are captured.
derived_reconciliation.volume_status: Venue-specific rolling 24-hour volume; do not sum into a consolidated market total.

etf_flow_sources.excerpt: Through 2026-11-06; 5 funds; Nov 6 net flow $0; last 7 sessions +$8.4M; 30-session +$45.9M; cumulative net inflow $1.73B. Page states no fund list, AUM, holdings or fees are published; flow series only.
etf_flow_sources.methodology: Flow-only series; the provider says its fund list, AUM, holdings and fees are not published. Cumulative net inflow is not current AUM or holdings.

etf_flow_sources.excerpt: As of the Nov 6 close, the tracker reports net outflows of 663,043 XRP (about $775.8K) across the six spot XRP funds plus BITW. Its methodology says GXRP is excluded from flow totals while its holdings remain included; flows are day-over-day changes in issuer-reported holdings, can include BITW rebalancing or XRP-denominated fees, and some historical rows are reconstructed.
etf_flow_sources.methodology: Flows are computed from day-over-day changes in issuer-reported holdings, not direct issuer creation/redemption reports. BITW rebalancing and XRP-denominated fee accrual can affect the delta. GXRP is excluded from flow totals during a data-gap correction while its holdings remain included.

etf_flow_sources.excerpt: Updated 2026-11-07 16:43 UTC; Nov 6 is partial (3 of 4 tracked funds), waiting for Franklin XRPZ. The page also reports a latest issuer file dated 2026-11-09 but read on 2026-11-07 05:12 UTC; that future-dated record is quarantined.
limitations: Nov 6 coverage is partial, 3 of 4 tracked funds.
A purported issuer file dated Nov 9 is future-dated relative to Nov 7 retrieval and is excluded from point-in-time use.
Do not infer missing-fund flow as zero.

macro_context.excerpt: Published 2026-11-06: global equity funds received $38.63B in the week through Nov 4, their seventh consecutive weekly inflow; global bond funds gained $9.91B; money-market funds received $172.71B, their largest weekly inflow since April 2020. Major US and Asian markets declined amid concerns about AI investment costs.
macro_context.interpretation: Mixed macro context: sustained equity and bond inflows coexist with unusually large money-market inflows and risk concerns. This is not an XRP-specific capital-flow measure.

source_independence.derivatives_note: TradRadar, Liqwall and Alpha Finance are separate aggregators, but their underlying exchange universes may overlap and raw venue receipts are not available here; do not count them as three independent confirmations.
source_independence.etf_note: Alpha Finance, XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole rely on overlapping issuer/fund information but apply different fund universes and transformations. Their values must remain separate; do not average.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The spot discount to daily/24h opens, reported net ETF outflow in XRP Insights, and long-dominated liquidations are consistent with risk-off pressure and long deleveraging.
supporting_evidence: Kraken last is 1.5898% below today's open.
OKX last is 1.6525% below its 24h open.
XRP Insights reports -663,043 XRP for Nov 6 across its flow universe.
TradRadar reports 6.89M long liquidations versus 261.01K short liquidations.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Alpha Finance reports zero Nov 6 flow across its five-fund flow-only universe.
Derivatives aggregators use different venue coverage and timestamps.
Macro equity funds still had a seventh consecutive weekly inflow.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Falling OI alongside long liquidations may represent forced position reduction rather than fresh short initiation.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports OI down 1.33% and long liquidations dominate.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No synchronized exchange-native OI time series or account-level position changes were captured.
Funding remains positive in the secondary aggregate.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The zero versus negative ETF-flow observations can arise from differing fund universes, missing reports, holdings-delta methodology and index-fund treatment rather than contradictory issuer cash flows.
supporting_evidence: Alpha Finance reports five funds and a flow-only series.
XRP Insights includes BITW, excludes GXRP from flow totals and derives flow from holdings changes.
CryptoKeyhole marks Nov 6 partial at 3 of 4 funds and exposes a future-dated issuer-file anomaly.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No common issuer-level creation/redemption reconstruction across all six spot funds and BITW was completed in this run.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Broad capital flows show both risk-seeking and liquidity preservation; neither a simple risk-on nor simple risk-off label is justified.
supporting_evidence: Global equity funds +$38.63B and bond funds +$9.91B in the week through Nov 4.
Money-market funds +$172.71B, largest weekly inflow since April 2020.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: These are global fund flows, not XRP or crypto-specific flows; timing and asset universes differ.

reasons: Kraken has no provider event timestamp.
OKX ticker timestamp is near the 300-second threshold and the exact retrieval clock is not independently anchored.
Only Level-1 quotes are captured; multi-level depth and slippage are missing.
USD and USDT are not normalized.
Derivatives and ETF aggregators have unmatched universes, timestamps and methodologies.
No issuer-complete ETF creation/redemption reconstruction was performed.

Backfill daily/hourly observations into the point-in-time feature store only after source and timestamp eligibility checks.
